title: Karger contraction terminates at two vertices
statement: Let $n \ge 2$, and let $T$ be an adaptive graph trace of $n-2$ contraction steps whose initial multigraph $T_0$ has exactly $n$ vertices. Then the final multigraph $T_{n-2}$, obtained after the $n-2$ successive edge contractions prescribed by the trace, satisfies the termination condition: it has exactly two vertices.
hypotheses_covered: T is an adaptive graph trace of n-2 steps
the initial graph T_0 has exactly n vertices
